crossRefs.note: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. Desolation and…
“Their feet are swift to shed blood.
“These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

translations.web: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
translations.bsb: As soon as he had received the morsel, Judas went out into the night.
translations.kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
translations.asv: He then having received the sop went out straightway: and it was night.
